mapper.sql:
FROM ( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD
,(SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN E.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' WHEN E.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '70' THEN '재심사' ELSE B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH E , CSPD112TI B WHERE E.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('60', '70', '100', '120') OR AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('40', '70')) AND (E.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3' OR E.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) AND E.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' ) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
, NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS XPBY_COL_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS CUS_KORL_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS CSNO , CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100', '130') THEN A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO ELSE A.AI_INSPE_ENO END AS CUR_ENO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO ,( SELECT LST_DB_CHG_DTM FROM CSPD001TM WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND TO_NUMBER(AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) < 80 ) AS PRE_AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO
, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) < 80 THEN (TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,'-',''),1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 ELSE 0 END AS DELAY_TIME
, (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('20', '60') AND AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT IS NOT NULL THEN '21' ELSE AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD END) KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC ) AS INPT_TASK_ID FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO ) AS STATUS
, Q.AI_SYS_INPT_PRG_STCD AS Q_PRG_STCD
FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E , CSPD202TM I , CSPD900TI Q WHERE A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = Q.INPT_MST_SRNO(+) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD NOT IN ('140', '160') AND A.PAPS_RE_SCAN_CMPL_YN IS NULL
AND A.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD IN ('1', '2')
AND A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{aiInptCmnCd}
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT , '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD AS AI_INPT_PROS_CD , A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS AI_INPT_ACVT_CD ,( SELECT MAX(B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM)KEEP( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY E.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO DESC) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD008TH E , CSPD112TI B WHERE E.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND E.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('100', '120') AND E.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '300' AND E.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' ) AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, I.TDOC_RCP_CUCD)AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD , NVL(E.XPBY_COL_AM,I.TDOC_RCP_AM) AS XPBY_COL_AM , NVL(E.CUS_KORL_NM,I.CUS_KORL_NM) AS CUS_KORL_NM , NVL(E.CSNO, I.CSNO) AS CSNO , CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD = '120' THEN A.QLAS_SNPE_ENO ELSE A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO END AS CUR_ENO , A.FX_REFNO_SRNO , NULL AS PRE_AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO
, 0 AS DELAY_TIME , NULL AS STATUS , NULL AS Q_PRG_STCD FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM E , CSPD202TM I WHERE A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD NOT IN ('140', '160') AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = E.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = E.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = I.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = I.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND A.QLAS_PRG_YN = 'Y' AND A.QLAS_CRPE_ENO IS NOT NULL AND A.PAPS_RE_SCAN_CMPL_YN IS NULL
AND '3' = #{aiInptCmnCd}
AND A.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{actlFxRefno}) || '%'
) Z , CSPD101TI U , CSPD112TI F , CSPD112TI X , CSPD112TI W WHERE U.AI_INPT_USER_ID = Z.CUR_ENO AND F.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.AI_INPT_PROS_CD AND X.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AND W.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND W.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = Z.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD
AND Z.CSNO = #{aiInptCusNo}
AND Z.CUR_ENO = #{inptBizAlctCrpeEno}
AND Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = #{inptAtvtCd}
AND Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD != '130'

SELECT Z.INPT_MST_SRNO --union된 001 테이블의 마스터번호 -- , Z.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT , Z.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD --union된 001 테이블의 업무구분 코드 -- , W.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM --업무 이름 (수출/수입/QA) -- , Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO --001 테이블의 Reference Number -- , Z.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS WRR_INFO --업무 액티비티 상태코드에서 뽑아온 주의정보 -- , CASE WHEN Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD != '130' THEN '진행' --액티비티 상태코드를 통한 진행구분 상태 (pending/진행) -- ELSE X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END AS JINGHENG , Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD --union된 001 테이블의 업무 액티비티 코드-- , F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_PRCSNM --업무 프로세스 명칭 (수입(출)선적서류 제재심사/자체점검(QA)-TotalText 등등) -- , X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS INPT_ATVTNM --업무 현재 액티비티 명칭 -- , Z.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS FC_CUNM --수출입 테이블(201, 202) 테이블로부터 뽑아온 통화 명칭 -- , Z.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM --수출입 테이블(201, 202) 테이블로부터 뽑아온 금액-- , Z.CSNO AS AI_INPT_CSNO --수출입 테이블(201, 202) 테이블로부터 뽑아온 고객번호-- , Z.CUS_KORL_NM AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM --수출입 테이블(201, 202) 테이블로부터 뽑아온 고객이름-- , Z.CUR_ENO AS INPT_BIZ_ALCT_CRPE_ENO --union된 001 테이블의 담당자 번호 -- , U.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS INPT_BIZ_ALCT_CRPE_FNM
, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(Z.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) < 80 AND (Z.Q_PRG_STCD IN ('16','24') OR Z.STATUS IN ('21','32','42','47')) THEN '오류' WHEN Z.DELAY_TIME > (SELECT AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = 371 AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = '01') THEN '지연' ELSE Z.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM END WARRNING , Z.STATUS , Z.DELAY_TIME
ORDER BY Z.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY Z.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY WARRNING
ORDER BY WARRNING DESC
ORDER BY Z.CSNO
ORDER BY Z.CSNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.CUS_KORL_NM
ORDER BY Z.CUS_KORL_NM DESC
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY F.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY X.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY Z.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD
ORDER BY Z.XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD DESC
ORDER BY Z.XPBY_COL_AM
ORDER BY Z.XPBY_COL_AM DESC
ORDER BY U.AI_INPT_USER_NM
ORDER BY U.AI_INPT_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY Y.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY Y.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY Z.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
